q: Reference string 7 0 1 2 0 3 0 4 2 3 0 3 2 with 3 frames par FIFO se kitne page faults?
explain: FIFO par is string mein 10 page faults aur 3 hits aate hain (hit ratio 3/13).

q: Usi 13-reference string aur 3 frames par kis algorithm mein sabse kam page faults aate hain?
explain: Optimal = 7, LRU = 9, FIFO = 10. Optimal hamesha minimum deta hai par future knowledge maangta hai.

q: Belady's anomaly kis algorithm mein hoti hai?
explain: FIFO mein kabhi zyada frames se zyada page faults ho jaate hain; LRU aur Optimal stack algorithms hain, inme nahi hoti.

q: Memory access 200 ns, page-fault service 8 ms, fault rate 0.001. EAT lagbhag kitna?
Thrashing ka sabse sahi matlab kya hai?
options: CPU bahut fast chal raha hai
System real work se zyada time pages swap karne mein lagata hai
Page table bahut bada ho gaya
explain: Thrashing mein itne page faults hote hain ki CPU execution se zyada swapping karta hai; CPU utilisation gir jaata hai.
